title: My shop
subtitle: The products you list. Nobody else's, and nobody else sees yours here.
renameHint: Changing this changes the name under every one of your listings at once.

empty.title: You have not listed anything yet.
empty.body: A product you list here appears in the catalogue straight away, with your shop name under it.

listing.loadFailed: Your listings could not be loaded.

create.title: List a product
create.name: Name
create.skuHint: Your own code for it. It has to be unique across the whole shop.

consequences.title: Three things this does, so nothing surprises you later
consequences.language: The text you type is stored in {{language}}. Shoppers reading the other language see this text until you translate it.
consequences.currency: The price is in {{currency}} only. Shoppers paying in the other currency will see the product but cannot buy it until it has a price there.
consequences.stock: A new listing has no stock, so it reads “out of stock” until it is stocked. Sellers cannot set stock yet.
